description: Antenas de Telecomunicação is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidade Intermunicipal do Alto Tâmega e Barroso. Telecommunications antennas are devices that allow the transmission and reception of communication signals, such as radio waves, TV, mobile telephony and wireless internet. They work by converting an electrical signal into an electromagnetic field that is transmitted through the air and then converting that electromagnetic field back into an electrical signal at the receiver. Coverage: Comunidade Intermunicipal do Alto Tâmega e Barroso. The portal shows the English title as "Telecommunication antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidade Intermunicipal do Alto Tâmega e Barroso. Its keywords include comunicacao, telecom, alto-tamega-e-barroso, rede. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ODS, GPKG. The listing shows 2023-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
